messages:
alex_r: Quick heads-up: rolling out a new Dedicated capacity offering in ap-southeast2 — small burst pools (4x A200s) for latency-sensitive inference. Launch window next Tuesday.

maria_prod: Nice. These are aimed at mid-market customers who need predictable p99s but don't want large reserved commits.

ops_jen: Ops notes: initial capacity limited; we'll gate by region quota and enable auto-scaling only after first 48h. Replacement policy = same-region only.

infra_bot: automated: Pool class 'burst-small-a200' created in ap-southeast2 by alex_r at 2026-04-22T07:00Z. See internal doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated/burst-small-a200

maria_prod: Billing/pricing: per-minute metered billing, same unit pricing as existing small pools. We'll publish sample cost per 1M tokens in the launch doc.

ops_jen: Runbook snippet: on high-failure-rate alerts, throttle new allocations and switch traffic to stable regional pools. Contact infra oncall if allocation failures >5% for 15m.

alex_r: Customer comms: short announcement to active Dedicated users 24h before region flips on. Contact sales for early access.

maria_prod: Will prepare announcement draft. Target GA after 2-week preview if health metrics look good.
thread_short_summary: Announcement: preview launch of small burst Dedicated pools (4x A200) in ap-southeast2; details on ops gating, billing, runbook, and comms.
